name: phd-transfer-cse-unplaced
description: DGS 2026-10-03 (P1-transfer-eligibility-23): a transferred non-CSE course may draw on §4.2’s nine-credit allowance, but only as the sheet rules — the ExternalCourses verdict (yes / no / dgs_approval / adgs_approval) decides whether it counts, and the row’s is_cse cell or the cse_subject_codes list decides which side of the nine it is on. Here the Parameters tab has no cse_subject_codes list and the row has no is_cse cell, so a pre-approved MA 51100 cannot be placed: it is held for the DGS (provisional, the §5.2 row “Waiting for the DGS”, the review request asking for the is_cse cell) instead of counting as CSE by default, which is what it did before.

detailIncludes: MA 51100: The course rules do not say whether it is a CSE course
